items.why: Zuckerberg unveiled Muse Wonder, a new frontier-class AI model that will power Meta's Muse agent for paying subscribers; shares jumped about 4% on the news.
Shares fell after Reuters reported a major 2027 chip-supply expansion, while ARK trimmed its stake and investors took profits after the sector's worst week in a month.
Fell with the chip group after a bruising week for semiconductors (SOXX down ~5%) on AI-spending worries and questions about OpenAI's revenue outlook.

market_note: Mixed close: Dow up, Nasdaq down as oil rallied.
summary: The Dow finished higher while the Nasdaq lagged as rising oil prices weighed on growth stocks. Meta was the day's standout mover on its new AI model launch.
